[[Thrill of the Hunt (enchantment)|Thrill of the Hunt]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Thrill of the Hunt (enchantment)|Thrill of the Hunt]]:''' "Lesser beings hunt for the prize, but for me, the hunt is prize enough."
On Hit: You have a small chance to attempt to hold a monster in place. Even if the [[Hold Monster|Hold]] is unsuccessful, their will saves will be reduced by 5.
